en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a rural riverside settlement with fields and scattered houses in the foreground, a large multi-span steel truss bridge crossing a wide river at mid-ground, and gently rising hills with more villages in the distance. The caption in the upper right reads "Niederwartha a. Elbe." The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
